title: Reset your Northstar Works password
content: For your own Northstar Works account, open https://accounts.northstar.example/reset and select Forgot password. Enter your work email, complete the registered MFA verification, and choose a new unique password. Never share passwords or verification codes. If you cannot complete MFA, contact the helpdesk for identity verification.

title: Windows VPN troubleshooting
content: On Windows, confirm that your internet connection works, then open Northstar Connect VPN and select the Corporate profile. Sign in using your work account and MFA. If connection fails, disconnect and reconnect once, then restart the VPN app. Record the error code for the helpdesk. Do not disable the firewall or antivirus.

title: Outlook crashes on startup
content: Save work in other apps and restart Outlook. If it still crashes, record the error message and app version and request a Software ticket draft. Do not delete mail profiles or local mail files without helpdesk guidance.

title: Laptop microphone checks
content: Check the physical mute switch and select the built-in microphone in Windows sound settings. Confirm that your meeting app has microphone permission. If the microphone remains unavailable, describe the issue in a Hardware ticket draft.
